name: The Captain's Chest
summary: Smotts' lost chest lies with a sea giant after a wreck near Booty Bay. Captain Hecklebury Smotts once sailed between Booty Bay and Ratchet in Kalimdor. Sea giants wrecked his ship and killed the crew, then sent him toward Booty Bay in a lifeboat. Gorlash took his Captain's Chest, and now Smotts wants it back.

sections.title: A Ruined Captain
sections.body: Captain Hecklebury Smotts once sailed between Booty Bay and Ratchet in Kalimdor, and earned a fine reputation. Then sea giants smashed his ship and killed the crew. They sent Smotts toward Booty Bay in a lifeboat, and he left his voyages and good name behind.

sections.title: The Stolen Chest
sections.body: Gorlash took Smotts' Captain's Chest, saying he wanted it for a snuffbox. The chest was Smotts' favorite, and a secret compartment held his greatest treasures. Smotts has heard that Gorlash roams the shore east of Booty Bay.

sections.title: Smotts' Thanks
sections.body: Smotts is overjoyed to have his chest back, and its return takes some fire from his anger. His revenge is still not complete.

faq.answer: Captain Hecklebury Smotts is a ship captain in Booty Bay. He once sailed between Booty Bay and Ratchet in Kalimdor, until sea giants smashed his ship and killed the crew.
Gorlash, one of the sea giants, took Smotts' chest and said he wanted it as a snuffbox.
Along the shore east of Booty Bay, by Smotts's account.

faq.q: Why does Smotts want the chest back?
aliases: why does smotts want the chest
faq.answer: Smotts wants his chest back because it was his favorite, and its secret compartment held his greatest treasures.
